==Introduction==
Hi, I'm '''Vruxir''' (roughly pronounced ''VROO-here'', [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:IPA IPA]: /ˈvru.xir/), AKA Kevin B.

I started studying Lojban in October 2010.

I was born in [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/New_York New York] and I now live in [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virginia Virginia], in the [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_States United States].

==Name==
The name "Vruxir" is assembled from the ''[http://vlasisku.lojban.org/vlasisku/rafsi rafsi]'' (abbreviated combining forms) of the Lojban words ''[http://vlasisku.lojban.org/vlasisku/savru savru]'' ("noise, din, clamor") and ''[http://vlasisku.lojban.org/vlasisku/xirma xirma]'' ("horse").

The combination of terms tickled my fancy, and the sounds reminded me of an Old Norse name, so I went with it.

Kevin is my birth name and the one used with most of my acquaintances.

==Still Learning==
I haven't finished memorizing the Lojban ''[http://vlasisku.lojban.org/vlasisku/gismu gismu]'' (five-letter content words including most basic "verbs", "adjectives", and "nouns"); but I'm continuing to study.
